newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks seen steadier on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks seen steadier on technicals.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen steadier on Wednesday after a technical recovery on Tuesday with selling pressures easing, dealers said.
A resurgence of fund orders could help the index sustain comfortably over 2,000 points, although some caution could be exercised ahead of May non-oil domestic data later this week.
"Some programme buying is returning so we could have bottomed out for now," a dealer with a foreign brokerage said.
On Tuesday, the Straits Times Industrials Index ended 13.18 points higher at 2,004.26.
But the broader market continued slightly defensive with losers outpacing gainers 180 to 156.
